summary: End-to-end integration suite over committed synthetic WAV fixtures: stdlib-only deterministic generator (scripts/make_fixture.py) producing tone/speechlike/silence 16kHz mono 16-bit fixtures (byte-reproducibility proven by test), plus 17 offline tests exercising the real CLI surface — all-formats batch into an output dir with JSON Transcript.from_dict round-trip and SRT/VTT/TSV structure regexes, FAIL_case batch isolation (exit 1, good files still written), byte-identical rerun determinism, and smoke-marked python -m transcriber subprocess tests (--version and --stdout transcription with clean streams).
